g.font-family: 'AriadneNSD Mono', D2Coding, Consolas, 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', monospace
g.text: flow = 0 # cap[u][v]: residual capacity, reverse edges included
cap[v][u] += b # so it can be undone

text.tspan: Push the flow along the path

g.text: parent = {s: s} # the path with the fewest edges
q and t not in parent
v not in parent and cap[u][v] > 0
